name: VAK Vocaal Ensemble vanaf 18 jaar
description_short: Singing fun in a team: chamber choir VAK Vocaal! Singing polyphonic choral music a cappella. From Renaissance to contemporary.
description_full: VAK Vocaal Ensemble from 18 years Back to the overview Singing pleasure in a team: chamber choir VAK Vocaal Ensemble As a chamber choir you form a team in which everyone has a major contribution and at the same time focuses on the group result. The end goal is to perform a piece of music beautifully, but the journey to get there is just as much fun. The VAK Vocaal Ensemble (VVE) is a chamber choir in which you sing polyphonic choral music a cappella. Our repertoire is 'classical' in the broadest sense of the word, from Renaissance to contemporary. Singing in a chamber choir for adults The VVE is something for you if you recognize yourself in these points: you have a fairly good singing voice for a group and preferably also experience with polyphonic (choir) singing; you are open to different (especially classical) music genres; you can follow along with sheet music in such a way that it helps you sing your part (singing directly from the sheet is not necessary); you have the time and inclination to practice your part at home, if necessary, using sound files; you enjoy performing a few times a year. Register Teachers Ivo Bouwmans Singing in a choir means working together. You concentrate individually and together. You take each other into account and know your role in the whole, so that the choir becomes a unit with a beautiful sound. For this you will learn to use your voice properly, intonate and listen carefully. In the VVE we sing beautiful, cheerful, moving and surprising songs from different countries and in different languages. The content is important. To represent the text through the music, you work on articulation, phrasing and dynamics. You will learn how a different way of performing can change the look of a song. In the process you also learn something about music theory. We sing works from different periods: from Renaissance music to contemporary music. About the lessons The VAK Vocaal Ensemble rehearses every week for an hour and a half, during which we alternate between short and long pieces. Afterwards, some singers often stay for a drink in OPEN. Got excited? Please contact the conductor for a voice test, or come and watch a rehearsal. Complete the trial lesson form. What should I bring? Your voice is your instrument. You must also have a good singing voice, but it does not have to be a particularly beautiful or loud voice. A chamber choir is not very suitable for really novice choristers. A small fee is charged for some sheet music. name: Young Free Academy Big Band
description_short: For young musicians who are looking for a challenge, teamwork and a broad, modern repertoire. Play, learn to improvise and grow as a musician!
description_full: Young Free Academy Big Band Back to overview Play together, learn to improvise and grow as a musician. The Young Free Academy Big Band is for young musicians who are looking for a challenge, teamwork and a broad, modern repertoire. The Young Free Academy Big Band (YFABB) is the younger sister of the Free Academy Big Band. An energetic and ambitious big band for young musicians who want to make music together, develop themselves and are ready for more depth. YFABB is for young people aged 8 to 21 who: play an instrument that fits within a big band can read notes are motivated to play and grow together Participating is not without obligation. If you are part of the big band, we expect you to be present at rehearsals and to practice the music at home. Practical Rehearsals: Tuesday evenings 7:30 PM - 9:00 PM Costs: We do not currently ask for a contribution, but we do expect you to commit yourself, be at the rehearsals and practice extra at home. Registration: click on the “Trial lesson” button at the bottom of the page to register. Fenna will contact you to schedule a trial rehearsal. Register Teachers What are you going to do? In the Young Free Academy Big Band you play in a permanent line-up with a modern and versatile repertoire. From real BigBand songs to pop music. Together with your band members you work on: playing together at a good level timing, sound and musical collaboration improvising growing in self-confidence and musicality We deliberately raise the bar. This means that you have to take into account regular extra practice outside of rehearsal. Building a strong bond together To further grow the big band, we are looking for more students so that we can work with a fuller line-up. If you already have music lessons at De VAK, that is nice, but it is not necessary. We are looking for additional horn players, guitar and a bassist who would like to grow with the band. But do you play another instrument that suits YFABB? Then please join us sometime. At the same time, we believe it is important to retain current students. Together we build continuity, quality and a pleasant, committed group atmosphere in which everyone can develop. Trial rehearsals Curious whether this suits you? You are welcome to participate in two trial rehearsals. Then we see together whether it feels good on both sides. It is necessary to register for a trial rehearsal. The trial rehearsals are free. Why YFABB? The Young Free Academy Big Band is for young musicians who want more than just taking lessons. You play together, learn to listen to each other, develop musically and are part of a band where commitment and fun go hand in hand. Would you like to be part of a big band where you are challenged and taken seriously? Register for two trial rehearsals and discover whether the Young Free Academy Big Band suits you. Who is your conductor? Fenna Volmer is the conductor of YFABB and as with FABB. Fenna is also a saxophonist and percussionist and mainly plays pop, jazz, soul and funk. “The DJBB served as my springboard to the conservatory, and I wish that for other students too!” Lesson format Group lesson Age from 8 to 21 years Lesson days Start Number of lessons Locations Intake Registration possible after start; you pay according to remaining lessons. name: Zingen en energie vanaf 18 jaar
description_short: Discover the power of your voice. Singing and energy work come together in this course in which you come home to yourself. Experience is not necessary.
description_full: Singing and energy from the age of 18 Back to the overview Discover your own voice Singing is so much more than making music. It is a way to come home to yourself, to feel who you essentially are again. Your voice is unique: your sound carries memories, feelings and strength. In this course you will go on a journey of discovery to that voice - and therefore to yourself. We combine singing with energy work in a safe, relaxed atmosphere. You will learn how to use simple techniques to collect, ground and distinguish your energy and what is yours - and what is not. Because sometimes we unknowingly take on tension or feelings from others. Sound helps you let go, clean up and make room for who you are. We work with breathing, feeling vibrations in your body and aura, and singing simple mantras and songs. Unison or – if you prefer – polyphonic. Each meeting focuses on a different body area. Together we bring that area into motion and into balance – with sound. No experience with singing is necessary. Curiosity and the desire to make your voice heard are enough. Fun and relaxation come first! Register Teachers Hannah Ybeles Smit Practical The course takes place on Wednesdays. Does Thursday morning suit you better? Let us know! Send an email to info@vak-delft.nl. If there are enough registrations, we will also start a group. Useful to know: Wear comfortable clothing that you can move easily in. name: Peuter vier x vier 2,5 t/m 4 jaar
description_short: In the four x four you and your toddler or preschooler go on a journey of discovery through the art disciplines: music, theater, visual arts and dance.
description_full: Toddler four x four 2.5 to 4 years Back to the overview In four x four you and your toddler or preschooler go on a journey of discovery through various art disciplines. Music, theater, visual arts and dance are featured on this journey and you will discover what suits you without having to choose. You will follow this course as a supervisor together with your child and explore together which discipline(s) awakens the artist in you. The course is in line with the child's perception of the world. Register Teachers Combiles teachers What are you going to do? Music: These lessons are a kind of tasting and orchestra for your ears. You will be introduced to different musical instruments and different ways of making music. The children learn to play together and listen. We play with balls, rhythm sticks, drums, bells, blocks, scarves or sound bars. Other pieces of music and activities invite movement, such as stomping, clapping, waving and dancing or jumping. Visual: In these lessons you will be introduced to different techniques that artists use. Sometimes very clean and sometimes very dirty. For example, what can be done with a chalk? We stick everything that is loose together into 1 large work of art and make collages from magazines and tissue paper. Of course we will also paint, because getting dirty is part of it. Brushes and paint together create wonderful worlds for a beautiful exhibition. Dance: What happens to your body when you move to music. Exercise is truly a basic need for toddlers and preschoolers! We make full use of this during lessons. By performing various dances and assignments together, the toddlers and preschoolers work on their motor skills in a playful way. Theater: What could be more fun than jumping into a puddle of water and getting everything wet, or walking through the forest like a dangerous tiger. By using assignments from their world, toddlers and preschoolers can empathize with someone else. They are actors in the making. (The order of the disciplines varies.) What are you wearing? Comfortable clothing and socks that can be removed during theater and dance lessons. For the art lessons, wear clothes that can get a little dirty. name: vier x vijf 6 t/m 8 jaar
description_short: Five lessons: goldsmithing, ceramics, singing and dancing. You try everything, experience everything and investigate what suits you best.
description_full: four x five 6 to 8 years Back to the overview Discover what you prefer to do The four x five is a follow-up course to the five x five standard and gives children the opportunity to taste everything independently. Five lessons: goldsmithing, ceramics, percussion and dance. You try everything, experience everything and investigate what suits you best. This course is for children who want to do everything or don't know yet what they like. The content of the lessons is in line with the experiences and level of the children. Register Teachers Combiles teachers What do you learn? Goldsmithing: These lessons cover various forms of jewelry making. Who wears jewelry and what are its meanings? From mayor's necklace to wedding ring and from bracelet to medal, these are all made by a blacksmith, who often works with gold and silver and very beautiful stones. In these lessons we also work with free materials and leave with a beautiful piece of jewelry after the lessons. Ceramics: is an encounter with the material clay. We are going to use hand molding and grinding to create work. What does clay feel like, how does clay work, what can and cannot be done with it. A journey of discovery through the properties of clay. Dance: You see the world through the eyes of a dancer. Visualize feelings of strength and freedom with your body, but how do you actually do that and how do you control your body? Dancing often happens together, you give each other space or not and this creates a choreography that can be performed in the theater. In this series of lessons you will discover what it is like to dance together. Percussion: Everyone can make music, in this block that is really the case, you work together to make music and form a beautiful orchestra to give a performance at the end of the 5 lessons. How does making music actually work? You need instruments for that. Instruments that already exist, but you also make your own instrument. With this colorful mix you will soon make dazzling music. What are you wearing? Wear comfortable clothing for all classes, for ceramics and silversmithing clothes that can get a little dirty, for dance classes you must wear cotton or woolen socks that can be taken off (and therefore no tights). name: vijf x vijf 4 t/m 6 jaar
description_short: Discover what you like to do most! visual arts, music, playing with language, theater and dance. Try everything and experience it.
description_full: five x five 4 to 6 years Back to the overview Discover what you prefer to do The five x five course has been a huge success for years and gives children the opportunity to get a taste of everything independently. But it is certainly also a course in itself. 5 lessons: visual arts, music, playing with language, theater and dance. You try everything, experience everything and investigate what suits you best. This course is for children who want to do everything or don't know yet what they like. The content of the lessons is in line with the children's experience and level. Register Teachers Combiles teachers What do you learn? Dance: Through play and various assignments, the children will develop their motor skills, coordination, flexibility, imagination and dance sense. They learn different dance styles and often work together to learn and perform the dance. At the end you will have a homemade dance performance! Music: These lessons are a kind of tasting and orchestra for your ears. You will be introduced to different musical instruments and different ways of making music. The children learn to play together and listen. They make music on rhythm instruments and boomwhackers, sing, explore instruments. Improvising and making music themselves turns the children into real musicians during the final performance. Visual: In these lessons you will be introduced to different techniques that artists use. Sometimes very clean and sometimes very dirty. For example, what can be done with scissors? We stick everything that is loose together into one large work of art and make collages from magazines and tissue paper. Of course we will also paint, because getting dirty is part of it. Brushes and paint together create wonderful worlds for a beautiful exhibition. Theater: who or what will I be today. During theater lessons you change characters so quickly that you can hardly keep up. From Mr Bean, to king, from king to cat, from cat to slippery snake. Playing is so much fun! Collaboration means working together and listening and looking at each other's skills. You will learn to work with different types of theater, such as improvisation and mime. At the end of this unit you will be on stage as a real actor. Playing with language: In these lessons we will work with stories and poems that you come up with. How do you put it on paper? In letters or in drawings. Because not everyone can write well yet, but the stories certainly find a place on paper. Stories about what you have experienced or seen and stories that arise from fantasy. We work from a storytelling circle, with stamps and drawing materials and of course with a pen. After a year you still can't choose? Then you simply do the five x five course again, because the course is different every year! What are you wearing? For all classes, wear comfortable clothing, for art and play and language classes, clothes that may get a little dirty, for theater and dance classes, children must wear cotton or woolen socks that can be taken off (and therefore no tights). description_full: Summer special toddler music and dance 2 to 4 years Back to overview Make music and dance together! Toddlers love music and dancing. In this course you can do that together! This special is all about summer. We sing summer songs, go to the beach, swim in the water and much more! The lesson has a fixed structure and varies by: Themes such as the seasons, holidays, etc. A story, a song or a fairy tale. Different materials: a ball, a feather, rubber ducks, a mouse, wipes, hoops and much more. Instruments: drums, triangle, xylophone, bells, piano, too many to mention. This lesson is for toddlers aged 2-4 years, with a parent, grandpa/grandmother or supervisor who actively participates. Register Teachers Hille de Jong Toddler Music and Dance also educational They also develop many social, motor and musical skills through play. Children really gain more self-confidence, but language and speech development is also promoted. But having fun together is the most fun! What are you wearing? Wear comfortable clothing. Street shoes must be removed. Children are always allowed to wear dance clothes or dress up. description_short: There are many associations related to TU Delft.
description_full: There are many associations related to TU Delft. The opportunities are countless, so It can be hard to find an association that suits you. To make this easier, we have made an overview in six categories: study, student, sports and culture and international associations, student teams and student organisations. We hope this helps you to find an association that is the best fit for you! Are you looking for more information about the associations or if you also want to be found on this page as an association, please contact the Student Community team via studentcommunity@tudelft.nl .
